# Confirm dismissed drafts expire without stale recovery prompts

## What & Why
A dismissed draft is intentionally temporary, but the recovery window should not leave an old prompt visible indefinitely or recover stale values after it expires.

## Done looks like
- The answer and opportunity recovery notices disappear after the configured recovery window.
- The expired draft cannot be recovered after the notice is gone.
- The behavior is covered in the browser persistence suite.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
